The house

A Cycladic escape in the heart of Ios

A house designed to experience Ios differently

Set slightly above Yalos beach, 400 metres away, the house looks out over Chora, the port and the Kampos countryside.

The village and its buzz are a few minutes away, but here all is calm. In the morning, you walk down to the beach. In the evening, you watch the lights of Chora come on from the terrace.

You have the whole house to yourselves, with no locked rooms, and its large outdoor spaces facing the Aegean Sea.

Cycladic architecture

A new house, built in the island's tradition.

Whitewashed walls, arches, pergolas and dry-stone walls echo the style of the houses of Ios.

The materials are those of the past: marble, wood, polished concrete and painted cement. They keep the house cool and play with the light from morning to evening.

Summer is lived outdoors.

The outdoor spaces

A large lounge for drinks and long evenings, a dining area in the shade of the pergola, a summer kitchen with a plancha for grilling the fisherman's catch, a hanging bed rocked by the Cycladic breeze and a sun terrace with eight loungers.

The Mediterranean garden

Fig trees, pomegranates, cacti and bougainvillea make up a typical Cycladic dry garden, fully enclosed.

On your way back from the beach, an outdoor shower awaits in the garden. In the evening, soft lights glow on the stone walls. A private parking space is kept for your car.

The bedrooms

Five beds across three bedrooms. Two bedrooms have their own bathroom; the third shares the common bathroom. A single bed in the lounge corner welcomes an eighth guest.

The owners' bedroom

The brightest room, with windows open to the view.

  • Queen-size bed
  • En-suite bathroom
  • View of Chora and the port
  • Ceiling fan

The guest bedroom

More earthy and intimate, with niches carved into the wall and soft light.

  • Queen-size bed
  • Shared bathroom
  • Mountain view
  • Ceiling fan

The ground-floor bedroom

Perfect for a family: children love climbing up to the mezzanine.

  • Queen-size bed
  • Single bed on a mezzanine
  • Private bathroom
  • Ceiling fan

The heart of the house

A fully equipped kitchen opens onto the dining room. Enough to cook for eight, even on evenings when the wind is too strong to dine outside.

Under the stairs, a lounge corner with a TV is made for reading or a nap. After dark, soft lighting takes over.

A shared bathroom in polished concrete, with its curved-wall shower, completes the common rooms.
